messages:
Samir (eng-release-owner): Quick sync — proposing cut window for 3.2 on Thu Mar 26 18:00 UTC. Go/no-go meeting 17:00 UTC (60m) to cover rollbacks, canary plan, and stakeholder signoff. Please drop availability and who owns canary/smoke by EOD today. @Maya K @Jordan P @Lee (infra) :calendar:

Maya K: I can do 17:00 UTC. I'll cover release notes and QA signoff. Who is handling DB migration check?

Jordan P: I can take migration preflight. Will run migration dry-run on staging today and post results.

Lee (infra): I'll own canary infra and smoke scripts. We need to confirm canary threshold: 95th perc latency < 400ms and error rate < 0.1% during first 30m. Ok?

Ana (prodops): SGTM. Add rollback criteria: revert to previous model variant and scale down new pool if error rate > 0.5% sustained 5m. Also need SRE oncall in the call.

Samir (eng-release-owner): Good points. Draft agenda below — anyone add items. Agenda:
```
- Quick rollcall (5m)
- Migration dry-run summary (10m) - Jordan
- Canary plan & thresholds (10m) - Lee
- Rollback criteria + runbook confirm (10m) - Ana
- Post-cut monitoring & escalation (15m)
- Final signoff (10m)
```
Also, please RSVP in the poll: https://poll.example.com/3.2-cut (drop your timezone).

Jordan P: +1. I'll paste staging dry-run logs in the thread once done.

Maya K: anyone available to review the release checklist? I flagged two items in the doc: https://docs.example.com/3.2/checklist :eyes:

Lee (infra): I'll review checklist now. Quick Q: do we want to enable KV-cache warmup before traffic? Adds ~3m to cut but reduces tail latency.

Samir (eng-release-owner): Yes, schedule a warmup step in runbook, mark as optional 'if latency risk high'.

ReleaseBot: Calendar invite created for 2026-03-26 17:00 UTC. Invite sent to participants.

Ana (prodops): Oncall rotation: @sre-tilt is covering that slot. I'll ping them to join.

Jordan P: Dry-run done. Dropping short log snippet:
```
migration: SUCCESS
latency_p95: 350ms
failed_checks: 0
```
No blockers.

Maya K: All right, checklist reviewed. I marked docs and client-facing notes. :thumbsup:

Lee (infra): I'll prepare canary smoke script and share command to run:
```
./smoke.sh --canary --duration=600 --qps=20
```

Samir (eng-release-owner): Thanks all. If no objections, I'll finalize agenda and lock meeting time by EOD. @Ana (prodops) can you confirm SRE attendance?

Ana (prodops): Confirmed. :white_check_mark:
